intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.042% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 1–900 s. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 5 TON pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (0 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 0 pairs priced on two or more venues, 0 apart after fees. TON ≈ $—.

rwa.verdict: 2 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Falcon: 6 pools from $0.9916 to $1.00779 (+1.63%), deepest on eth at $1.0005. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.

costume.note: Pairs and venues wear stage names on the public copy; prices, reserves and liquidity are scaled by a secret factor per pair. Counts, spreads, gas, hours and outcomes are the real study.
